capabilities: Generate inline flashcards from an open note or a selection
Generate multiline flashcards with configurable separators
Set custom prompts, card quantity, tags, and token budget
Choose OpenAI models, including reasoning models, via API key
Override settings per command with a settings-on-the-fly command
disambiguation: It does not schedule or review flashcards itself; it only generates them and relies on the obsidian-spaced-repetition plugin for studying.
extras: README warns that multi-line flashcard generation sometimes fails and suggests specific models (gpt-4o, gpt-4-turbo) for better results; a demo video is referenced but unavailable in the text; future features like reversed cards and automatic decks are planned but not present.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to automatically turn note content into flashcards; users must write study cards by hand.

relations.evidence: This plugin is designed to work with the obsidian-spaced-repetition plugin

summary: LLM plugin that generates inline and multiline flashcards from notes using OpenAI models, formatted for the Spaced Repetition plugin.
